page_title: GEN 0-1 FIO | Genoa v Fiorentina 31/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' Alan Matturro (Genoa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Chiffi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+2' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
90+2' A cross from Fabio Miretti (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+1' The resulting corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Tommaso Rubino (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Genoa.
89' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle. Genoa earn a free kick.
87' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
86' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
86' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
86' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina). Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
84' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

84' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' Here is a change. Riccardo Sottil is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
83' It is time for a substitution. Tommaso Rubino (Fiorentina) is on for Lucas Beltran.
81' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but David de Gea makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
80' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Morten Thorsby is replaced by Gaston Pereiro (Genoa).
79' The game has come to an end for Stefano Sabelli. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
77' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) receives a yellow card!
77' Dodo (Fiorentina) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Genoa have a free kick.
75' A clumsy foul by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

75' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but David de Gea shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is replacing Edoardo Bove.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Colpani departs the field of play to be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
71' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator makes way for Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fabio Miretti (Genoa) for Milan Badelj.
69' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
69' Aaron Martin (Genoa) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
67' It looks like Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Chiffi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Fiorentina are awarded the free kick.
65' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Amir Richardson.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
62' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
62' A pass by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
58' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) commits a foul during an attacking move. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
56' Dodo (Fiorentina) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
55' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick.
54' A pass lands at the feet of Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
52' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
52' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' The players claim that Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
51' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' Dodo (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
47' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+2' Dodo (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
44' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
41' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
40' Close! Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
37' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
36' Dodo (Fiorentina) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Nicola Leali is alert and denies him.
35' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
34' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
31' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
30' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) takes the corner with a short pass.

30' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.

27' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
25' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

23' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
21' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Genoa will take a free kick.
20' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) commits a foul and Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a free kick. Free kick. Fiorentina will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.
18' Dodo (Fiorentina) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
16' Dodo (Fiorentina) is flagged for offside.
15' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
15' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
12' Aaron Martin (Genoa) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
11' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina). Daniele Chiffi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
10' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
9' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
8' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Dodo (Fiorentina) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Genoa.
7' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
6' The foul by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Chiffi.
6' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

4' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
2' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Chiffi ignores the protests.
2' Milan Badelj (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but David de Gea comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi is the one to supervise the game today.
